item.title: Department of War’s decision to end ties with Harvard prompts debate
item.description: For the coming 2026-27 school year, the military will no longer send active-duty officers to Harvard for fellowships, certificate programs, or graduate-level Professional Military Education.

item.title: WATCH: These bureaucrats were CAUGHT ON CAMERA defying DEI restrictions
item.description: OPINION/ANALYSIS President Trump is cracking down on DEI in higher education. But are colleges actually getting rid of it, or just playing word games? In this video, College Fix editor Gabrielle Temaat breaks down shocking undercover footage from Accuracy in Media exposing administrators at major public universities admitting they’re still pushing DEI behind the scenes.

item.title: Texas State University lets socialist club run amok, but cracks down on conservatives
item.description: OPINION: A student says Texas State University is discriminating against conservative student organizations by not enforcing policies with the Young Democratic Socialists of America chapter on campus.
